lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are organized in staggered horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a grid-like distribution across the visible mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating nodal intersections at the blob centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are present across the flank, with the most distinct exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient characterized by high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density clustering of smaller, more irregularly shaped high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more uniformly spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
